notes: The Ethernet switch is optional in the manual; the two Optas can be connected directly with one RJ-45 cable. The recommended switched topology is modelled.
The manual's hardware list has 2 RJ-45 cables, so the 'Modbus TCP Compatible Device' box from the overview diagram (an optional extra field device) is not modelled.
Both USB-C cables go to the single computer; the laptop catalogue entry has one USB port, so both cables attach to it (a hub or two ports is implied).
Power supply (12-24 V DC) is not shown connected in the manual, so no power edges are included.
Static IPs: Server 192.168.1.2, Client 192.168.1.1, subnet 255.255.255.0. Software config (Modbus node, cnt variable at 25000, PLC code) is not part of the physical graph.
usb-cable has no ports in the catalogue, so its edges use null ports.
